english.title: Sell offensive weapon to a person under 18 years of age
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) sold to **(..SPECIFY PERSON..), a person under the age of 18 years,

(A)_[a knife]_
(B)_[a knife blade]_
(C)_[a razor blade]_
(D)_[an axe]_
(E)_[an article, namely **(..SPECIFY ARTICLE..), which had a blade or was sharply pointed and which was made or adapted for use for causing injury to the person]_
english.legislation: Contrary to section 141A of the Criminal Justice Act 1988.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
sold to a person under eighteen years of age
a knife/axe/knife blade/razor blade OR
article which had a blade or was sharply pointed made/adapted for use for causing injury to the person

investigatoraction.description: DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
(i) This section does not apply to flick knives, gravity knives, any article described in the Criminal Justice Act 1988 (Offensive Weapons) Order 1988, folding pocket knives with blades of less than 3 inches and shaving cartridges (section 141A(3)).
(ii) See offence wording H1729 for the offence of selling offensive weapons under section 141.
(iii) Age increased to 18 years by section 43(2) of the Violent Crime Reduction Act 2006.

other.penalty:
Six months imprisonment and / or a fine not exceeding level five on the standard scale.

Time limit for prosecutions:
6 months

On the 12th March 2015 the limit on fines imposed by a Magistrates’ court was removed – as such, the potential fine on summary conviction in relation to an offence committed after this date is unlimited.
